name: Actuator-Aware Runtime Safety After Transfer Failure

protocol: calibration seeds 10000-10019; untouched test seeds 12000-12099; fresh fault seeds 13000-13099; 0.30 s horizon
comparators: P unfiltered proposal; LM lumped instantaneous-command filter; AA actuator-aware filter
main_interpretation: AA improves severe stuck-proposal containment over P and LM; transparent in all healthy scenarios

name: Risk-Bounded Energy Admission and In-Flight Adaptation
provenance: independent physics-grounded simulation; synthetic battery/mission environment; not electrochemical, HIL or flight
protocol: 12,000 model-fit + 12,000 risk-calibration + 48,000 untouched final missions (8 scenarios x 6,000); kappa=2.689 for 97.5% one-sided coverage
main_interpretation: Reserve violations among admitted missions 2.11% (DET) -> 0.112% (RISK) -> 0% (ADAPT); headwind/compound coverage ~93% and long/compound conservatism remain

name: Equal-Budget Classical vs QUBO/Quantum-Inspired Fleet Optimization
provenance: synthetic but physics-grounded fleet instances; CPU Simulated Bifurcation (not quantum hardware)
protocol: 144 untouched instances x 3 solvers; end-to-end deadlines 0.10/0.25/0.50 s; offline optimum or <=1e-4 MIP-gap reference
main_interpretation: SB-QI has larger gaps than both classical methods at equal deadline and low raw feasibility; QI loses privileged status
